counterexample_or_failure_condition: the approval predates an affected repair or is not independently grounded
expected: the approving actor independently verifies the current affected scope
known_bad_detection_method: Supplied unsupported-conclusion control (fabricated completed pilot, 20% time cut, all-department migration next quarter) was judged against the source brief and rejected on three grounds; staged reconstruction preceded exposure to source and anchors.
limitations: One agent application and readback; no human-comprehension claim; no causal or comparative superiority claim; focused test run only, not full-suite receipt.
observed: Staged AC-3 exercise: opening alone, then Roadmap alone, then full packet; both reconstructions were returned before the source brief or anchors were opened. Anchor scores: (1) team keeps repair knowledge across staff changes: recovered ('a small municipal maintenance team keeps its knowledge despite turnover'). (2) shadow builds on working spreadsheet, no invented missing records: recovered ('Today that history sits in a working spreadsheet'; 'reversible shadow trial ... beside the working sheet'). (3) adoption, recovery, training and support gate crew rollout: recovered ('gated on real use, recoverable data, and an owner for training and support'). (4) no demonstrated gain, next step investigates it: partial ('The time saving is unproven'; most important uncertainty 'whether the queue reduces work or adds to it'), but I framed the shadow test as asking whether the queue keeps history and did not say it also tests whether repeated entry falls. (5) operator authority retained, shadow is not cutover: recovered ('The sheet stays the authority and nothing is cut over'; 'opt-in supervisor as owner'). Claim check against the source brief: no unsupported or overstated claim and no lost uncertainty. Evidence limits (one supervisor report, no field-worker adoption, no pilot, no measured gain), authority of the sheet, no cutover, conditions instead of dates and the failure response all survive. Ranking reduced work as 'the most important open question' is an interpretive emphasis that the evidence gap supports. Control: rejected. The source records no completed or controlled pilot and no comparative time saving, so the 20% figure is fabricated; 'next quarter' contradicts conditions-not-dates; migrating all departments contradicts single-crew gating and no authorized production cutover. AC-1 and AC-2 are supported by the guidance diff: the guide adds the governing thought, distinct support, summaries that follow from evidence, flexible grouping, visible uncertainty, Minto attribution and the precedence of artifact contracts, with no fixed counts or gates. The seed 179 and review companion edits are mirrored verbatim in the local prompts and keep alternatives-first authoring, staged reconstruction and the bounded review. test_writing_guide_delivery.py: 5 tests OK (focused run). Limits: one agent reader and one application. This shows no human comprehension and no causal or model-adherence superiority over the prior guidance.
proposition: qa-reviewer approves the current affected scope
safety_and_authorization: Local review evidence only; no external side effects.
